single-purpose Rails 8 API that implements a small subset of D&D 5e\nutilities for a staged benchmark. The server is intentionally lightweight: no\nActive Record models, no view layer, no background jobs, and only the\n`action_controller` and `railtie` parts of Rails are loaded.\n\n## Starting and verifying the server\n\nThe server is started from the project root with the provided wrapper:\n\n```bash\nPORT=4567 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` runs `bundle exec rackup -o 127.0.0.1 -p \"$PORT\"` in the foreground, so\nPuma listens on the requested host and port and logs to stdout. To verify it:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:4567/health\n```\n\nExpected response:\n\n```json\n{ \"ok\": true }\n```\n\nA smoke test that exercises the main endpoints is:\n\n```bash\nBASE=http://127.0.0.1:4567\ncurl -X POST \"$BASE/v1/storage/reset\"\ncurl -X POST \"$BASE/v1/auth/register\" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{\"username\":\"dm\",\"password\":\"password123\",\"role\":\"dm\"}'\ncurl -X POST \"$BASE/v1/dice/stats\" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{\"expression\":\"2d6+3\"}'\n```\n\n## Entry point and major files\n\n| File / Directory | Purpose |\n| ---------------- | ------- |\n| `run.sh` | Foreground server wrapper. Uses `PORT` and binds to `127.0.0.1`. |\n| `config.ru` | Rack entry point. Loads `app.rb` and mounts `Rails.application`. |\n| `app.rb` | Defines the Rails application (`Dnd::Application`), loads the shared\n  storage module, and initializes the database. |\n| `config/routes.rb` | All HTTP routes grouped by domain. One explicit route per\n  endpoint, no resource macros. |\n| `app/controllers/` | One controller per domain. All inherit from\n  `ApplicationController`, which parses JSON bodies and provides shared 400/401\n  helpers. |\n| `app/controllers/concerns/dnd_rules.rb` | Shared domain rules and validation\n  helpers: initiative math, encounter difficulty, identifier validation,\n  ability modifiers, proficiency bonuses, and `find_campaign`. |\n| `app/models/game_storage.rb` | Shared SQLite3 persistence module. Bypasses\n  Active Record and uses raw SQL plus a global mutex for write safety. |\n| `Gemfile` / `Gemfile.lock` | Pinned dependency set: Rails 8.1.3, Puma 8.0.2,\n  Rack 3.2.6, Rackup 2.3.1, SQLite3, BCrypt. |\n\n## State, persistence, and request routing\n\n### Persistence\n\nState lives in a single SQLite3 database file named `game.db` in the project\nroot. The schema is created by `GameStorage.init` on startup, so the server is\nself-initializing. Tables include:\n\n- `users` — DM/player accounts with BCrypt password digests.\n- `combat_sessions` — active combat order and conditions as JSON columns.\n- `monsters` and `items` — compendium entries.\n- `campaigns`, `campaign_characters`, `campaign_events` — campaign state.\n- `quests`, `factions`, `npcs` — campaign narrative state.\n- `inventory` — campaign inventory entries and assigned equipment.\n- `crafting_projects` — downtime crafting progress.\n- `sessions`, `session_attendance` — scheduled sessions and attendance.\n- `play_campaigns`, `play_campaign_members`, `play_campaign_events` —\n  authenticated turn-based play surface.\n- `play_campaign_documents` — public story and private DM notes.\n- `play_campaign_scenes` — scenes that can be opened, entered, and closed.\n- `play_campaign_locations`, `play_campaign_location_connections` — location\n  graph and travel edges.\n- `play_campaign_encounters` — combat encounters with combatants, conditions,\n  turn order, and rewards.\n- `play_campaign_spells` — per-character spellbook entries validated against the\n  character's class.\n- `schema_version` — schema marker used by the storage status endpoint.\n\nThe connection is opened lazily by `GameStorage.db`. All writes and any\nread-modify-write sequence are wrapped in `GameStorage.with_lock` because the\nPuma server runs multi-threaded and the SQLite3 build in this workspace is not\nconfigured for concurrent writers.\n\n`GameStorage.init` calls `create_schema` (the single source of truth for a\nfresh database) and then a compact set of migrations grouped by table:\n`migrate_play_campaigns`, `migrate_play_events`, `migrate_play_members`,\n`migrate_play_documents`, `migrate_play_scenes`, `migrate_play_locations`, and\n`migrate_play_encounters`. Each migration is idempotent: it adds missing\ncolumns or creates missing tables only when they are absent. The `reset`\nendpoint drops every managed table and recreates them from `create_schema`, so\ntests always start from a deterministic, empty state.\n\n### Request routing\n\nRoutes are explicit in `config/routes.rb`. No namespaces, no generated helpers.\nEach route maps a verb + path to a single controller action. For example:\n\n```ruby\npost '/v1/combat/sessions/:id/advance', to: 'combat_sessions#advance'\n```\n\nPath parameters are available through `params[:id]`, and the parsed JSON body is\navailable through the `@body` instance variable populated by\n`ApplicationController#parse_json_body`.\n\n### Controllers\n\n`ApplicationController` is the API base. It:\n\n1. Runs `before_action :parse_json_body` for every action.\n2. Returns `400 { error: 'invalid json' }` if the body is malformed.\n3. Provides `bad_request(message)` for 400 responses.\n4. Provides `require_authentication` and `require_dm` for the play surface.\n\n`DndRules` is included in `ApplicationController` so every concrete controller\nhas access to shared validation (`valid_id?`, `valid_non_empty_string?`) and\nD&D 5e math (`initiative_order`, `build_party_thresholds`, `modifier_for`,\n`proficiency_bonus`, etc.). It also provides `find_campaign(id)` for 404-aware\ncampaign lookups.\n\nConcrete controllers keep validation and domain logic together. They return the\nexact JSON shapes the cumulative evaluator expects. Prefer `valid_id?` and\n`valid_non_empty_string?` over inline regex so the identifier rules stay in\none place, and use `find_campaign` after validating the id to avoid changing 400\nvs 404 semantics.\n\n## Main API / domain groupings\n\nEndpoints are grouped by controller under the `/v1/` prefix:\n\n- **Health** — `GET /health` liveness probe.\n- **Auth** — `POST /v1/auth/register`, `POST /v1/auth/login`.\n- **Dice** — `POST /v1/dice/stats` parses expressions like `2d6+3`.\n- **Checks** — `POST /v1/checks/ability` evaluates d20 + modifier vs. DC.\n- **Encounters** — `POST /v1/encounters/adjusted-xp` computes difficulty.\n- **Initiative** — `POST /v1/initiative/order` sorts combatants by score.\n- **Characters** — ability modifier, proficiency bonus, and derived stats.\n- **Combat Sessions** — create, add condition, and advance a stored combat round.\n- **Storage** — `GET /v1/storage/status`, `POST /v1/storage/reset`.\n- **Compendium** — create/read monsters and items.\n- **Campaigns** — create campaigns, add characters/events, read aggregate state.\n- **Quests / NPCs / Factions / Inventory / Downtime / Sessions** — campaign\n  management sub-resources.\n- **PHB** — spell slots, long rest, and equipment load rules.\n- **DM Tools** — encounter builder, loot parcel, and session recap.\n- **Play Campaigns** — authenticated `/v1/play` surface. Only authenticated `dm`\n  users may create, start, narrate, nudge, and resolve turns; players join,\n  submit actions, and read their own turn context. The document endpoints let\n  the DM write a public story and private DM notes; players read only the story.\n- **Scenes / Locations / Encounters** — the play surface also manages scenes,\n  a travel graph of locations, and turn-based combat encounters with monsters,\n  party combatants, conditions, damage, healing, and rewards.\n- **Character Ownership / Build / Level / Skills / Spells** — players can claim,\n  transfer, build (race/class/background/abilities), level up, roll skill\n  checks, and maintain a class-validated spellbook for their own characters.\n\n## Play campaign turn flow\n\nThe turn queue is deterministic and derived from the insertion order of party\nmembers (`ORDER BY ROWID`). After the DM starts a campaign, the queue alternates\n`player -> dm -> next player`. The current actor is stored in\n`play_campaigns.current_actor`, and events are appended to\n`play_campaign_events` with monotonically increasing `sequence` values.\n\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/:id/actions` — a player submits an action; the event\n  is stored with `kind = 'action'` and `next_actor = 'dm'`; the current actor\n  moves to the DM.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/:id/resolutions` — the DM resolves the latest action;\n  the event is stored with `kind = 'resolution'` and `next_actor` set to the\n  next player in the queue; the current actor and turn number advance.\n- `GET /v1/play/campaigns/:id/turn` and `GET /v1/play/campaigns/:id/my-turn` —\n  read the current actor and recent events. Players see only public fields; the\n  DM sees the full party and GM context.\n\nCombat encounters transition the campaign into `phase = 'combat'` and save the\nprevious actor in `saved_actor`. When the encounter ends, the campaign returns\nto `phase = 'exploration'` and restores the saved actor. The play surface uses\nthe same deterministic initiative order for encounter combatants: descending\ninitiative, with insertion order as the tie-breaker; an explicit `order_json`\noverrides the default sort once delay/ready actions are used.\n\n## Conventions for extending and testing\n\n### Adding an endpoint\n\n1. end\n\n    unless duration_rounds.is_a?(Integer) && duration_rounds > 0\n      bad_request('invalid duration_rounds')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    encounter_id = params[:enc_id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      unless campaign[1] == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      encounter = find_encounter(campaign_id, encounter_id)\n      return unless encounter\n\n      combatants = JSON.parse(encounter[3] || '[]')\n      unless combatant_exists?(combatants, target)\n        render json: { error: 'target not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      conditions = JSON.parse(encounter[6] || '{}')\n      conditions[target] ||= []\n      conditions[target] << { 'condition' => condition, 'remaining_rounds' => duration_rounds }\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET conditions_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?',\n        [JSON.generate(conditions), campaign_id, encounter_id]\n      )\n\n      render json: {\n        target: target,\n        conditions: conditions[target].map { |c| { condition: c['condition'], remaining_rounds: c['remaining_rounds'] } }\n      }, status: :created\n    end\n  end\n\n  def encounter_status\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    enc_id = params[:enc_id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      unless campaign_member?(campaign_id, username, campaign[1])\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      encounter = find_encounter(campaign_id, enc_id)\n      return unless encounter\n\n      round, turn_index, active = current_encounter_state(encounter)\n      combatants = JSON.parse(encounter[3] || '[]')\n      ordered = encounter_turn_order(combatants, encounter[7])\n      conditions = JSON.parse(encounter[6] || '{}')\n\n      existing_keys = ordered.map { |c| combatant_key(c) }.to_set\n      conditions_map = {}\n      conditions.each do |key, list|\n        next unless existing_keys.include?(key)\n        conditions_map[key] = list.map { |cond| { condition: cond['condition'], remaining_rounds: cond['remaining_rounds'] } }\n      end\n\n      render json: {\n        round: round,\n        turn_index: turn_index,\n        active: active ? || (encounter[9] && encounter[9] != '[]')\n        render json: { error: 'rewards already awarded' }, status: :conflict\n        return\n      end\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET xp_awarded = ?, loot_json = ? AND id = ?',\n        [xp, JSON.generate(loot), campaign_id, encounter_id]\n      )\n\n      render json: {\n        id: encounter_id,\n        xp: xp,\n        loot: loot\n      }, status: :ok\n    end\n  end\n\n  def close_encounter\n    encounter_id = params[:enc_id]\n    unless valid_id?(encounter_id)\n      bad_request('invalid encounter id')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      unless campaign[1] == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      encounter = find_encounter(campaign_id, encounter_id)\n      return unless encounter\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?',\n        ['closed', campaign_id, encounter_id]\n      )\n\n      xp_awarded = encounter[8] || 0\n\n      render json: {\n        id: encounter_id,\n        status: 'closed',\n        xp_awarded: xp_awarded\n      }, status: :ok\n    end\n  end\n\n  def end_encounter\n    encounter_id = params[:enc_id]\n    unless valid_id?(encounter_id)\n      bad_request('invalid encounter id')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      unless campaign[1] == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      campaign_state = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT phase, saved_actor, current_actor FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n      phase = campaign_state[0] || 'exploration'\n\n      if phase != 'combat'\n        render json: { error: 'campaign is not in combat' }, status: :conflict\n        return\n      end\n\n      encounter = find_encounter(campaign_id, encounter_id)\n      return unless encounter\n\n      if encounter[2] == 'active'\n        GameStorage.db.execute(\n          'UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?',\n          ['closed', campaign_id, encounter_id]\n        )\n      end\n\n      restored_actor = campaign_state[1] || campaign_state[2]\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET phase = ?, current_actor = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      unless member\n        render json: { error: 'target not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      hp_current = member[1] || 20\n      hp_max = member[2] || 20\n      status = member[3] || 'conscious'\n      successes = member[4] || 0\n      failures = member[5] || 0\n\n      new_hp = [hp_current - amount, 0].max\n      new_status = status\n      new_successes = successes\n      new_failures = failures\n\n      if new_hp == 0 && status != 'dead'\n        new_status = 'unconscious'\n        new_successes = 0\n        new_failures = 0\n      end\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ?, death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [new_hp, new_status, new_successes, new_failures, campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      render json: { target: char_id, hp_before: hp_current, hp_after: new_hp, damage: amount }, status: :ok\n    end\n  end\n\n  def death_saves\n    outcome = @body['outcome']\n\n    unless outcome.is_a?(String) && %w[success failure].include?(outcome)\n      bad_request('invalid outcome')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    char_id = params[:char_id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      member = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT username, status, death_save_successes, death_save_failures FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      unless member\n        render json: { error: 'target not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      unless member[0] == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      status = member[1] || 'conscious'\n      successes = member[2] || 0\n      failures = member[3] || 0\n\n      unless status == 'unconscious'\n        render json: { error: 'character is not unconscious' }, status: :conflict\n        return\n      end\n\n      new_successes = successes\n      new_failures = failures\n      new_status = status\n\n      if outcome == 'success'\n        new_successes = [successes + 1, 3].min\n        new_status = 'stable' if new_successes >= 3\n      else\n        new_failures = [failures + 1, 3].min\n        new_status = 'dead' if new_failures >= 3\n      end\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET status = ?, death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      unless member\n        render json: { error: 'character not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      unless member[2] == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      new_owner_member = GameStorage.db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      unless member\n        render json: { error: 'character not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      owner = member[2]\n      unless owner == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET race = ?, class = ?, background = ?, hp_max = ?, hp_current = ?, abilities_json = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [race, class_name, background, hp_max, hp_max, JSON.generate(abilities), campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      render json: {\n        character_id: char_id,\n        race: race,\n        class: class_name,\n        background: background,\n        level: level,\n        hp_max: hp_max,\n        proficiency_bonus: proficiency_bonus\n      }, status: :ok\n    end\n  end\n\n  def level_up\n    level = @body['level']\n\n    unless level.is_a?(Integer)\n      bad_request('invalid level')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    char_id = params[:char_id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      member = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT username, character_id, owner, level, hp_max, class, abilities_json FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      unless member\n        render json: { error: 'character not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      owner = member[2]\n      unless owner == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      current_level = member[3] || 1\n      unless level == current_level + 1 && level <= 20\n        bad_request('invalid level')\n        return\n      end\n\n      class_name = member[5]\n      hit_die = HIT_DICE[class_name]\n      unless hit_die\n        bad_request('invalid class')\n        return\n      end\n\n      abilities = JSON.parse(member[6] || '{}')\n      con_score = abilities['con']\n      unless con_score.is_a?(Integer) && con_score >= 1 && con_score <= 30\n        bad_request('missing abilities')\n        return\n      end\n\n      con_mod = modifier_for(con_score)\n      hp_increase = average_die(hit_die) + con_mod\n      new_hp_max = (member[4] || 0) + hp_increase\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET level = ?, hp_max = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [level, new_hp_max, campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      render json: {\n        character_id: char_id,\n        level: level,\n        hp_max: new_hp_max,\n        hit_dice: \"1d#{hit_die}\",\n        proficiency_bonus: proficiency_bonus(level)\n      }, status: :ok\n    end\n  end\n\n  def skill_check\n    skill = @body['skill']\n    ability = @body['ability']\n    proficient = @body['proficient']\n    roll = @body['roll']\n\n    unless VALID_SKILLS.include?(skill)\n      bad_request('invalid skill')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless ABILITY_NAMES.include?(ability)\n      bad_request('invalid ability')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless proficient == true || proficient == false\n      bad_request('invalid proficient')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless roll.is_a?(Integer)\n      bad_request('invalid roll')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    char_id = params[:char_id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      member = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT username, character_id, owner, level, abilities_json FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      unless member\n        render json: { error: 'character not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      owner = member[2]\n      unless owner == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      abilities = JSON.parse(member[4] || '{}')\n      score = abilities[ability]\n      unless score.is_a?(Integer) && score >= 1 && score <= 30\n        bad_request('invalid ability score')\n        return\n      end\n\n      level = member[3] || 1\n      modifier = modifier_for(score) + (proficient ? proficiency_bonus(level) : 0)\n      total = roll + modifier\n\n      render json: {\n        character_id: char_id,\n        skill: skill,\n        ability: ability,\n        modifier: modifier,\n        total: total\n      }, status: :ok\n    end\n  end\n\n  def add_spell\n    spell_id = @body['spell_id']\n    name = @body['name']\n    level = @body['level']\n\n    unless valid_id?(spell_id)\n      bad_request('invalid spell_id')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless valid_non_empty_string?(name)\n      bad_request('invalid name')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless level.is_a?(Integer)\n      bad_request('invalid level')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    char_id = params[:char_id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      member = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT username, character_id, owner, class FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      unless member\n        render json: { error: 'character not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      unless member[2] == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      unless spell_valid_for_class?(spell_id, member[3])\n        render json: { error: 'invalid class/spell combination' }, status: :bad_request\n        return\n      end\n\n      begin\n        GameStorage.db.execute(\n          'INSERT INTO play_campaign_spells (campaign_id, character_id, spell_id, name, level) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n          [campaign_id, char_id, spell_id, name, level]\n        )\n        render json: { spell_id: spell_id, name: name, level: level }, status: :created\n      rescue SQLite3::ConstraintException\n        render json: { error: 'duplicate spell' }, status: :conflict\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def list_spells\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    char_id = params[:char_id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      is_owner = campaign[1] == username\n      is_member = GameStorage.db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?',\n        [campaign_id, username]\n      )\n\n      unless is_owner || is_member\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      member = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT character_id FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      unless member\n        render json: { error: 'character not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      spells = GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'SELECT spell_id, name, level FROM play_campaign_spells WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? ORDER BY level, spell_id',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      ).map do |row|\n        { spell_id: row[0], name: row[1], level: row[2] }\n      end\n\n      render json: { spells: spells }, status: :ok\n    end\n  end\n\n  private\n\n  # Return all party usernames in insertion order. The queue is built from this\n  # order, so every call site must use the same `ORDER BY ROWID` clause.\n  def party_usernames(campaign_id)\n    GameStorage.db.execute(\n      'SELECT username FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ?
